title: Salary statistics
statementMd:
Compute the lowest, highest and average salary across all employees. Round the average to **2 decimal places**.

Expected columns: `min_salary`, `max_salary`, `avg_salary`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT MIN(salary) AS min_salary, MAX(salary) AS max_salary, ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM employees;
```

Several aggregates can be computed in one pass over the table.

expected.query: SELECT MIN(salary) AS min_salary, MAX(salary) AS max_salary, ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM employees;
